note: The blank-code case. Fails if the code "" stops being an item like any other: listed first (items are in `ord` order, the value set's codes sorted bytewise, so "" < "1" < "2": `reg-frame/src/lib.rs` line 193, `vs_item.ord` is the index in that order), counted in `total` and `n_items`, found by `q`, or found by the pair (code "", label) mode, which lists both value sets that hold it (svar18 and svar20) ordered by hash. Only `valueset_id IS NULL` means no value set. The hashes are the SHA-256 of the canonical item list, recomputed independently of the build.
